user.title: Daikin Altherma 3 (DCOM-LT/MB)
user.description: Connect to the DCOM-LT/MB through a Modbus TCP gateway. Use 'RTU over TCP' for transparent RS485 gateways.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read from the DCOM-LT/MB. Check host, port, address and framing.

init.title: Options

data.smart_mild_temp: Smart heating: mild day above (heat only inside the window)
data.smart_off_temp: Smart heating: no space heating above
data.smart_room_sensor: Smart heating: room temperature sensors and/or thermostats (optional)
data.smart_room_target: Smart heating: room target (for plain sensors; thermostats use their own)
data.smart_room_mode: Smart heating: room that drives the correction
data.smart_rooms_off_pause: Smart heating: pause heating when all selected thermostats are off
data.smart_early_start: Smart heating: early start for cold rooms (outside the mild-day window)
data.smart_early_start_shortfall: Smart heating: early start when a room is this far below target
data.smart_compressor_rest: Smart heating: rest the compressor after the unit stops it
data.cop_electricity_sensor: COP: heat pump electricity sensor – power (W/kW) or energy meter (kWh); empty = no COP

init.description: Smart heating settings are used when the 'Smart heating control' switch is on. Outdoor temperatures are averaged over about an hour. The heating curve points and the mild-day window are set on the dashboard with the 'Heating curve ...' and 'Smart heating window ...' entities. The compressor rest times are set on the dashboard with the 'Compressor rest …' entities.

error.off_below_mild: 'No space heating above' must not be lower than the mild-day temperature.
